messages:
maya: hey @sam @ops-oncall — need temporary admin (break-glass) for prod-db to run a small migration now. ETA ~20m. can someone approve? i'll record commands and upload audit.

sam: quick question — what's the exact change? i need a jira link + short runbook to approve. slack-only approvals are only for emergencies.

maya: JIRA INF-4893. one nullable column add + backfill (no data model changes). runbook below. will not print PII. plan: 1) connect to cloudsql 2) ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN prefs JSONB; 3) backfill in 10k batches with sleep 4) verify counts and revoke creds. estimate 15m.

alex: can you confirm if we need CloudSQL admin role or just DB superuser via ephemeral creds? also share sanitized SQL so i can review locking implications.

maya: cloudsql ephemeral admin (no long-lived keys). commands i'll run: ```
# connect
gcloud sql connect prod-db --user=postgres --quiet
# schema
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN prefs JSONB;
# backfill (example loop)
UPDATE users SET prefs = '{}' WHERE prefs IS NULL LIMIT 10000;
# repeat in a loop with pg_sleep(1) between batches
```

eng-security: tagging sec team — note that break-glass must follow the access portal flow unless this is an immediate outage. we need: jira + justification in the access request + approver noted. also confirm logs will not contain raw emails/PII.

security-bot: reminder: to request temporary elevation use `/access-request prod-db admin --jira=INF-4893 --duration=30m --justification="migration backfill (no PII)"` — include start/end times and approver.

ops-oncall: if INF-4893 exists and /access-request is submitted i'll approve for 30m. @alex can you do a quick script sanity check for locks?

alex: will review in ~10m. @maya please paste a sanitized diff of the SQL migration (no emails or identifiers).

maya: uploaded sanitized diff to INF-4893 (removed emails/user_ids). submitting access request now. standing by.

security-bot: Access request submitted by maya. Resource: prod-db. Role: admin. Duration: 30m. Approver: ops-oncall. Status: pending.

ops-oncall: Approved — granting 30m break-glass. conditions: run during off-peak windows, set job logging to mask user_email and set `log_level=error` for the backfill. notify when starting and when revoking.

maya: thanks. starting now. will stream high-level progress to #incidents-private and keep logs sanitized.

maya: done — migration finished with no errors. rows updated: 42128. rotating/revoking ephemeral creds now.

security-bot: Elevation revoked for maya. Duration used: 28m. Audit record: https://audit.internal/1769501234

sam: thanks — can you paste a 2–3 line postmortem in the JIRA (what changed, duration, rows touched, any follow-ups)?

maya: done — added postmortem to INF-4893: added prefs col (nullable), backfilled 42,128 rows, no errors, follow-up: add test for prefs default in migrations repo.
